title: Safar may aakhri
body:
safar may aakhri daulat luta ke rote hai
hussain turbat e asghar bana ke rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kis charaagh ko ay shaamiyon bujha daala
ke jis ki yaad may jhoke hawa ke rote hai
safar may aakhri daulat...
<<DIVIDER>>
madine waalon ko khalta tha girya e zehra
hussain is liye jangal basa ke rote hai
safar may aakhri daulat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamare ghar may bhi hoti hai majlis e shabbir
hamare ghar may bhi sajjad aa ke rote hai
safar may aakhri daulat...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane ashkon se kya likh diya hai sughra ne
pisar ki laash pa shah khat suna ke rote hai
safar may aakhri daulat...
<<DIVIDER>>
rabab ko dar e qaima pa dekh kar maula
zuban se kuch na kaha sar jhuka ke rote hai
safar may aakhri daulat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hua hai dasht may pamaal haye ibn e hassan
hussain laash ke tukde utha ke rote hai
safar may aakhri daulat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bilal shaam e ghariban ki yaad aati hai
chalo charaghe shab e gham bujha ke rote hai
safar may aakhri daulat...
author: Bilal Kazmi
